title: Claude-to-Compose design retrofit and native proof gallery
current_focus: Build and verify an isolated native gallery for both Note Overlay Claude designs before touching the production app

tasks.title: Freeze a bounded local-first v1 workflow and versioned artifact contract
tasks.acceptance: Astra-reviewed v1 scope defines inputs, outputs, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED semantics, and excludes unsupported claims

tasks.title: Inspect an Android repository and emit an evidence-backed existing-app model
tasks.acceptance: The CLI identifies real modules, UI symbols, state/action clues, tests, build commands, revision, and unresolved uncertainty without mutating the app

tasks.title: Build a design-to-existing-app retrofit contract and coding-agent packet
tasks.acceptance: A captured design spec plus app model produces versioned JSON and Markdown mapping obligations, preservation invariants, unsupported features, and exact next commands

tasks.title: Run fail-closed visual and behavioral acceptance with structured defects
tasks.acceptance: Complete fixture evidence passes, missing evidence blocks, and historical false-green visual evidence fails; results are consistent across CLI JSON and report output

tasks.title: Package, document, independently review, and publish the v1 branch
tasks.acceptance: A clean-clone user can run doctor, initialize a project, inspect an app, create an agent packet, and exercise the verification fixture using documented commands; dedicated branch is pushed to GitHub

tasks.title: Inventory every distinct design direction, state, and interaction in both supplied artifacts
tasks.acceptance: A source-linked inventory and geometry/hash-verified static references cover da63 and all 35 e34f sections plus 33 figures at two named 4:3 outer viewports; interaction and motion remain explicitly outside this phase

tasks.title: Replicate the da63 overlay as reusable native Android UI over a synthetic article
tasks.acceptance: A buildable Compose proof screen renders the toolbar and representative tool/opacity states in portrait and landscape with inspectable captures and working controls

tasks.title: Replicate the e34f toolbar directions and theme variants
tasks.acceptance: Every distinct toolbar direction and day/night/high-contrast variant in the source matrix has a native selectable proof state and matching reference context

tasks.title: Replicate the e34f beyond-the-bar interactions and supporting chrome
tasks.acceptance: Gesture, glass, ink, selection, page, first-stroke, mildliner, preset, popup, snip, small-control, and onboarding examples have native inspectable states; unsupported behavior is explicit

tasks.title: Compare native renders and interactions against pinned Claude references
tasks.acceptance: Exact APK, viewport, state, render, interaction, and visual-difference evidence are tied together; negative controls fail; no source-only or test-count-only green claim

tasks.title: Deliver a testable proof app and honest comparison gallery for choosing a direction
tasks.acceptance: Owner can compare the native variants and Claude references, exercise controls, and see remaining mismatches and device limitations before any production graft

tasks.title: Graft a chosen, validated native design into a disposable Note Overlay design branch
tasks.acceptance: Only after proof validation and design selection, restyle the existing chrome on a codex design branch while preserving the ink and persistence invariants; no main-branch or live-data mutation

tasks.title: Add deterministic interaction timelines and physical DC-1 release evidence
tasks.acceptance: Authored scenarios replay with controlled clocks and the exact artifact passes named hardware checks
